sections.title: Habit and origin
sections.text: Crinodendron hookerianum is a dense evergreen shrub or small tree native to Chile, usually reaching 4–8 m in cultivation. Its leaves are narrow and toothed. It prefers a sheltered position and moist, acidic soil.

sections.title: Lantern-shaped flowers
sections.text: In late spring and summer, its red, hanging lantern-shaped flowers are about 2.5 cm long and are followed by a capsule. The plate matches the toothed leaves, lantern flowers and capsule. No reliable food use was found.
